During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict fought in [[3996 BBY]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-influenced [[Mecrosa Order]], a secret society of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and expert [[Poison/Legends|poisoners]] sponsored by [[House Mecetti]],<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> '''assassinated''' the leaders of four rival [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble houses]]<ref name="KotORCG" /> in the [[Nyssa system/Legends|Nyssa system]].<ref name="TEA" />

During [[Tapani Day]] festivities, [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] of the Mecrosa Order attempted to simultaneously dispose of the leaders of five of the eight rival Tapani [[Noble/Legends|noble]] houses, including Houses [[House Barong|Barong]], [[House Calipsa|Calipsa]], [[House Melissus|Melissus]], [[House Pelagia|Pelagia]] and [[House Reena|Reena]]. Of these, only House Pelagia managed to foil the plot.<ref name="KotORCG" />

Following these assassinations, the [[Mecetti Province]] absorbed the territories of Barong, [[Calipsa Province|Calipsa]] and Melissus, as well as a portion of [[Reena Province|Reena]].<ref name="KotORCG" />
